core_step: Create /root/patches directory to hold patch files
why_essential: Patch files must be placed under /root/patches as required by the task before applying them to the repository

core_step: Write the patch file CVE-2021-25646-SamplerResource.patch into /root/patches
why_essential: The patch file contains the code changes that fix the empty-key JavaScript bypass and must exist for review/auditing and application

core_step: Apply the patch by writing the updated SamplerResource.java into the repository
why_essential: Modifying SamplerResource.java is the code change that intercepts and rejects exploit payloads; the repository must contain the patched source for the build

core_step: Run the Maven build to compile the patched indexing-service module (skip web-console and code quality checks)
why_essential: A successful build produces the patched JAR that the verifier will deploy; the specified Maven flags ensure the build avoids OOM and skips checks for patched files
evidence: "mvn clean package ... -pl '!web-console' -pl indexing-service -am" and "Command running in background ... Output is being written to: ..."

core_step: Verify the patched JAR was created at /root/druid/indexing-service/target/druid-indexing-service-0.20.0.jar
why_essential: The verifier will deploy this JAR; confirming its existence ensures the fix was compiled and is ready for deployment

core_step: Verify the patched SamplerResource class is present inside the built JAR
why_essential: Confirms the specific patched class (SamplerResource) was compiled into the JAR so the security fix is included in the artifact to be deployed
